button.label: Remove Duplicates
button.screentip: Remove duplicates in the selected range
button.supertip: Removes duplicate rows from the currently selected cell range.

button.label: Validate Dates
button.supertip: Highlights cells in the selected range whose text looks like a date but is not a real calendar date (for example, 35.02.2026).

button.label: Digitize Chart
button.screentip: Convert a chart image into Excel data
button.supertip: Captures a chart image (screenshot, clipboard, or file), calibrates the value axis, and extracts the data points into an Excel table.

toggleButton.label: Show Formulas
toggleButton.screentip: Show formulas instead of cell values
toggleButton.supertip: Displays the formula used in each cell instead of the calculated value. Click again to restore the cell values.

button.label: Trace Precedents
button.supertip: Displays tracer arrows showing which cells feed into the active cell's formula.

button.label: Trace Dependents
button.supertip: Displays tracer arrows showing which cells depend on the active cell.

button.label: Remove Arrows
button.supertip: Removes all visible tracer arrows from the active worksheet.

button.label: Insert Slide
button.screentip: Insert a PowerPoint slide as an image
button.supertip: Inserts an image of a PowerPoint slide and stores the file path plus slide number for later refresh.

button.label: Refresh Slide
button.supertip: Re-exports the linked slide and replaces the picture at the same position and size.

button.label: Link as Table
button.screentip: Link the range to PowerPoint as a table (values only)
button.supertip: Creates a native table on the active PowerPoint slide from the selected cell range and stores the data source for later refresh. Transfers displayed values only.

button.label: Values Only
button.supertip: Transfers only the displayed cell values, without font, fill, alignment, or borders.

button.label: With Formatting
button.supertip: Also transfers font family, size, bold/italic, color, cell fill, alignment, and borders from Excel.

button.label: Linked Ranges
button.supertip: Lists all linked ranges in this workbook and selects the range you choose. Broken references are removed from the registry.

toggleButton.label: Highlight Links
toggleButton.supertip: Temporarily gives every linked range a distinct color. Click again to restore the normal worksheet view; original cell formatting is not changed.

button.label: OEROUND
button.supertip: Rounds to the nearest multiple, while deviating where needed so totals stay consistent.

button.label: OEROUNDNEAR
button.supertip: Forces rounding to the nearest multiple.

button.label: Remove
button.supertip: Removes the OEROUND functions from the selected cells.

button.label: Highlight
button.supertip: Highlights cells that were rounded to the farther multiple.
